You are a TLA+ specification engineer. You will receive a natural language description of a system. Produce a complete, syntactically correct TLA+ specification that faithfully captures the described behavior. The output must be a valid TLA+ module that passes the SANY parser. Include the MODULE declaration, EXTENDS, CONSTANTS, VARIABLES, Init, Next and Spec. Include all safety invariants and liveness properties described, and any fairness conditions mentioned. Output only the TLA+ specification.

System description: This module specifies the non-blocking atomic commitment (NBAC) algorithm with crash failures, based on Raynal 1997, using a TLA+ encoding. The system models processes that vote YES or NO, exchange messages, may crash, and observe a local failure detector that can nondeterministically report whether some process has crashed. The specification defines initialization, per-process steps combining message receipt, failure detector updates, and local transitions, and verifies structural properties such as type correctness and a validity condition relating unanimous YES votes to possible commit outcomes.
